text: alex.wong: Quick design review — mock attached: compact pool card (min/max stepper + burst pill + SLO microcopy). Main concern: on narrow widths the burst pill overlaps the stepper buttons and the min value gets truncated. Can we avoid reflow while keeping the card compact? tess_reynolds: I noticed that too. Two ideas: 1) move the burst pill to the far right as a separate chip so it never overlaps controls, or 2) collapse numeric steppers to a single 'min · max' label with [+] and [-] flyout on tap for mobile. Option 2 reduces visual density but may hurt discoverability. mike_choi: +1 on moving the pill right. Technically simpler: flex row with .pool-meta { flex:1 } and .burst-chip { margin-left:auto }. Avoids layout jumps. Will need to check when pool name wraps. dana_ops: Accessibility nit: when the stepper collapses we must preserve clear keyboard focus order and ARIA labels. Suggest aria-labels like `aria-label=\"Increase max replicas\"`. Also confirm touch target >= 44px for the pill. tess_reynolds: UX question for SLO slider: should we show absolute latency values (ms) or relative buckets (Fast / Balanced / Cheap)? Product asked for both in different places. I prefer ms for precision, but buckets are easier for quick config. Maybe show buckets by default and reveal ms on hover/focus. alex.wong: Product context: teams set SLOs in ms in the API, but many PMs want a simpler slider. Hybrid sounds good. Also, tooltip copy should explain tradeoffs (e.g., \"Lower latency increases cost; choose Balanced for steady workloads\"). mike_choi: CSS note: when we move the pill right, add `min-width` to the stepper container so numbers don't collapse: `.stepper { min-width: 96px }`. For compact card variant, we can reduce padding. tess_reynolds: Copy tweak for burst pill — currently says \"Burst\". Suggest \"Burst capacity\" or show quanta when available: \"Burst +4 GPUs\". More explicit and helps with discoverability. dana_ops: A11y run checklist: tab order, visible focus ring, high contrast ratio for pill text >= 4.5:1, aria-live for burst state changes so screen readers hear when a burst takes effect. Example: `div role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\">Burst enabled: +4 GPUs\`. mike_choi: Implementation question: what do we do when multiple burst policies exist? Should the chip show an aggregate (e.g., \"Burst +max 8\") or the active policy name? I think active policy + ellipsis for more details on hover. alex.wong: Decision: show active policy summary on the chip (e.g., \"Burst +4 (peak)\"). On click open popover with full policies. Also keep an inline \"why this matters\" microcopy under SLO slider in compact mode. tess_reynolds: Quick accessibility microcopy proposal for stepper: \"Min replicas — the minimum number of GPUs kept warm.\" Keep it short. dana_ops: Action items: - tess_reynolds: update mock with pill right-aligned, compact min/max label variation, and new microcopy. - mike_choi: prototype CSS changes + ensure focus states. - dana_ops: run a quick axe pass on the new mock and validate color contrast. - alex.wong: confirm copy with product and update the spec. aria-bot: Deployment note: please tag tickets with `ui-autoscale-compact` and link designs in the ticket. alex.wong: Thanks all — will sync on Friday for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
